idea.name: Leased strip-mall event venue with tech-driven marketing
idea.one_liner: Lease a 3,000 sq ft ex-church retail unit with ample parking, DIY build-out for ~$30K, and rent it by the 6-hour block for birthdays, showers, repasts, weddings and weekly church services, filled via hyper-local Facebook/Instagram ads, milestone-birthday direct mail and a QR photo wall that captures guest leads
idea.customer: local families (esp. 50-70 milestone birthdays), churches, couples, community groups
idea.offer: event space rental with decor packages, LED screens and photo wall
idea.revenue_model: per-event rental $1,000-4,000 (weddings $7,000), church monthly rentals $1,000-1,500, $350 deposit

key_quotes.quote: Yeah, so $100 in Facebook ads and got $10,000 in bookings.
And I and so now I target 3 months out to that milestone birthday.
So, right now, my latest numbers is about 8%of those people have have booked stuff.
I have three churches right now that are every Sunday.

claims.quote: And then on average, I think I did the average a little while ago, we were right at like 16, like 15.9 is like And profit?
And what's your average profit on a a $16,000 month? Would be about 8,000.

claims.claim: Three churches at $1,000/month each cover the rent
claims.quote: And I think all three of those are currently on the 1,000 a month.
So, 4,000, how much profit you make on a $4,000 event?

acquisition_channels.details: organic Instagram build-in-public videos (pulling carpet, building DJ booth)
Facebook/Instagram ads geofenced to 5-7 miles; community-specific (Somali, Ethiopian) creatives
EDDM postcards (~$0.50) targeting milestone birthdays 3 months out, three touches
QR-code photo wall captures guests' phone/email; 8% later book; automated Google review requests
free networking events for Chamber of Commerce to fill weekdays

ideas.delivery: owner and wife only, owner on site at start/end; GoHighLevel for bookings/tours; Instant Spotlight photo wall; tables and chairs from Facebook Marketplace (~$5K)
ideas.other_uk_rules: Premises licence/TENs under Licensing Act 2003 for regulated entertainment or alcohol; fire risk assessment; planning use class (sui generis/F2) for event use; UK GDPR for guest data captured via QR

idea.name: Dedicated shared church space rental
idea.one_liner: A generic space rented on rotation to small congregations for Sunday services plus weekday Bible studies and pastor office time, with an upsell to live-streaming setups
idea.offer: time-slot church space, live-stream equipment and training
idea.revenue_model: monthly slot rental $1,000-1,800 plus ad-hoc $150 weekday bookings

key_quotes.quote: So, that that's I get more calls phone calls on churches than I get on any other thing.
And so I advertise both packages, your regular and then there's like $1,800 a month package where I'll train somebody how to to how to live stream.
And my ads on church space well outperform everything else.

acquisition_channels.details: organic Instagram posts about church space availability

idea.name: SBA-funded event venue in a low-competition market
idea.one_liner: Event venue in Chesapeake, Virginia opened 7 days after lease with a ~$50K SBA loan, charging double Atlanta prices and booked into 2028

key_quotes.quote: He took a SBA loan for like 50 grand and was open 7 days after he did his lease.
They're booking into 2028 at this point.

claims.quote: It's like a little over 3,000 for bare-bones.
